acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

collision_energy.evidence: Peptide fragmentation was performed via higher energy collisional dissociation (normalized collision energy of 30%), and MS2 spectra were recorded in the Orbitrap at 30K resolution (isolation window 1.3 m/z, AGC target value of 400%, maxIT of 54 ms, and dynamic exclusion of 35 s).

enrichment_method.evidence: The abundance of the mutated peptide KIF2C (P13L; peptide sequence:  RLFLGLAIK) on peptide-pulsed (0.1 and 1µM) versus transgenic minigene-expressing cell lines (U698M, A2058, Mel15 LCL) was assessed using HLA class I immunoprecipitation followed by mass spectrometry analysis of the HLA peptides.
